name: Flat-Field Illumination Correction
description:
Perform pseudo-flat-field correction to fix uneven illumination in the 'Blobs' sample image.

1. Open 'Blobs (25K)' (File > Open Samples > Blobs).
2. Measure the mean intensity in 4 quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) to document the uneven lighting.
3. Create an illumination model by duplicating the image and applying a large Gaussian Blur (radius ~40-60).
4. Use the Image Calculator (Process > Image Calculator) to divide the original image by the blurred model. (Note: Result may need 32-bit conversion or scaling to be visible).
5. Measure the mean intensity of the same 4 quadrants on the corrected image to prove uniformity.
6. Save the corrected image to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/flatfield_corrected.tif
7. Save a CSV report with columns 'Quadrant', 'Mean_Before', 'Mean_After' to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/illumination_report.csv
